problem:
$$
f(x)∼\frac{{a}_{0}}{2}+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{a}_{n}\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{3}x)+{b}_{n}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{3}x)
$$

Let $F(x)=x$ for $x\in [-3,3).$ The Fourier series of the $6$-periodic extension $f(x)$ of $F(x)$ is shown above. Find the exact value of ${a}_{0}.$

${a}_{0}=$ {{field-1}}
worked_solution:
For the Fourier series of a $2L$-periodic function, the constant term is given by

$$
{a}_{0}=\frac{1}{L}{\int }_{-L}^{L}f(x)\,\text{d}x.
$$

In our case, $L=3$ and $f(x)=x$ for $x\in [-3,3).$ So, substituting into the formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{0} & =\frac{1}{3}{\int }_{-3}^{3}x\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{3}{[\frac{1}{2}{x}^{2}]}_{-3}^{3} \\  & =\frac{1}{3}(\frac{{3}^{2}}{2}-\frac{(-3)^{2}}{2}) \\  & =\frac{1}{3}(\frac{9}{2}-\frac{9}{2}) \\  & =0.\end{aligned}
$$
